unresolvedItems.note: Session 1 first-pass: parser-coverage signal is in `summary`. Full UnresolvedItemAggregator output (resolver / dynamic-SQL / navigation / function-classification) requires the live enrichment pipeline and is wired by harvester-finish-canonical-golden-output. `totalCount` and `bySourceAndReason` are intentionally omitted (not zero) to signal that no measurement has occurred. Property-sheet bucket coverage uses a Jet-SQL wrapping heuristic with a synthetic placeholder operand inserted for Access-criteria forms (`Is Not Null`, `In (...)`, etc.); see ParseSuccessReportGenerator.ParseAsJetWhere for details.
